blurb: Guests can race on three different tracks designed for different skill levels: a Kid track (5 years and up), a Junior track (9 years and up), and an Adult track with karts reaching speeds up to 75 km/hr. A short mandatory video training is required before each session. The facility provides all necessary safety equipment and daily inspects karts for safety.
